note: Music lab takes. Not wired into the game.

takes.influences: Neil Young (Dead Man), Gustavo Santaolalla, Ry Cooder (Paris, Texas)
takes.desc: One reverb guitar note at a time over an organ drone; the theme half-asleep.
takes.prompt: Night, a man asleep on a park bench under a blanket. Solo electric guitar with deep spring reverb and slow tremolo, one note at a time with long silences between, a soft pump organ drone on D underneath, distant and dusty. 60 BPM, D minor. Built on one simple, singable, wistful original melody: it rises F, A, C and falls gently back to G. Played very slowly and left unfinished. Hushed, dignified, sleepy. Steady from the first second, no intro and no fade ending, so it can loop as video game background music. Instrumental, no vocals, original melody.

takes.influences: Neil Young (Dead Man), Gustavo Santaolalla, Ry Cooder (Paris, Texas)
takes.desc: Three notes F, A, C; the last note never comes. Feedback fades.
takes.prompt: A short instrumental video game cue, no vocals, original melody. A death on the street: a single reverb electric guitar plays three slow notes, F, A, C, and stops before the last note; the feedback rings out and fades into silence over a low organ drone in D minor. Quiet, dignified.
